== Summary ==
How many copies of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]] each Light Side archetype played on Day 1 of the [[2020 World Championship]]. Columns 0–4 are the copy count, and each row total is the number of decks.

* '''Event:''' [[2020 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 9 December 2020
